result.scientific_strategy:
## 59709a6b-6a0b-4fa1-95e7-9b9cba8cdeed / Scientific strategy

**Current synthesis:** The campaign objective is at least 98% official success. The best measured policy remains the experiment-2 baseline checkpoint-100352 (`working`): 2330/2400 = 97.08% pooled over five distinct research panels (seeds 20000, 21000, 22000, 23000, 24000), plus a 98.0% reading on the reused task-reference panel; that reading is a favorable 200-episode sample, and the same artifact scored 97.5%, 95.5%, 96.7% and 98.0% on individual 200-600 episode panels, so 97.1% is the best-supported level. Every one of the policy's 70 measured failures lies in the folded-required sector: the 5.7% of targets (136/2400) whose open-elbow IK shoulder angle, once wrapped, exceeds the arm's ±170° hinge range. In that sector success is 66/136 = 48.5%, but it is not uniform. It is ordered sharply by the wrapped open-branch shoulder value, not by target depth: 49/52 (94%) for |wrapped open shoulder| 170-176°, 16/23 (70%) for 174-176°, but only 1/61 (2%) for 176-180°. The ordering is non-monotonic in the raw geometry: among targets whose raw open shoulder passes -180°, those with raw magnitude 180-184° succeed 1/30 while those deeper than 184° succeed 37/39, even though the deeper targets are geometrically harder. Three interventions left the objective unmet and are best read together as one negative family: experiment 3 removed the training-radius mismatch with no measured change; experiment 4's terminal-precision reward reshape degraded open-feasible behavior without touching the sector; experiment 5 replaced the out-of-range open configuration with the folded one, erasing the open/folded branch distinction, and collapsed folded success from 18/33 to 0/33 on its panel. Training proxies (success_rate near 1.0, ep_rew_mean) disagreed with measured behavior in all three runs.

**Lessons and limits:** Reusable: measured task outcome, not training success_rate or ep_rew_mean, must select models. Behavior within a late plateau is homogeneous, so checkpoint selection inside a plateau is low-value. The folded/open kinematic partition is the cleanest structural predictor of failure, and inside it the wrapped open-branch shoulder value orders success far better than radius, target angle, or folded-elbow geometry. Representation changes to the branch inputs are high-variance under transfer: erasing the open/folded distinction destroyed even the previously-solved shallow folded cases, so any change must preserve the branch contrast. Limits: one training seed and one recipe lineage; only seven checkpoints measured; the folded/open partition and the seam ordering are kinematic and feature computations from recorded per-episode diagnostics, not joint-trajectory or limit-contact measurements, so the seam is an observed association with the input representation rather than a demonstrated causal mechanism. The task-reference panel is reused and selection-contaminated.

**Open questions:** Whether the deep folded-required residual is caused by the open-branch input sitting on the ±180° angular wrap seam, or instead reflects an intrinsic precision/optimization limit of the 64x64 policy in the folded configuration, is not yet decided; the raw-versus-wrapped non-monotonicity favors the seam but does not prove it. Whether the marginal deep failures are static offsets or small limit cycles is not captured by the recorded diagnostics. Whether the 98.0% task-reference reading reflects a genuine level or one-panel variance remains open. These are recorded uncertainties, not a queue of required actions.
